The Eggs September 2024 page (illness onset from May 23) provides corroboration for the May–July window. A second iteration targeting specific June–July 2024 outbreak vehicles, FDA advisories with case counts, and Food Safety News/CIDRAP articles will substantially improve corroboration across multiple outbreaks and fill hospitalization/death/subnational gaps.

top_result_summaries.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to backyard poultry grows to 104 illnesses, 1 death | CIDRAP
top_result_summaries.snippet: # Salmonella outbreak linked to backyard poultry grows to 104 illnesses, 1 death. A multistate *Salmonella* outbreak has grown in just a few weeks from 7 to 104 cases, with 1 death now recorded, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) said in an update yesterday. Since its previous update on May 5, the CDC has confirmed 97 new cases, and the number of affected states rose from 6 to 35. The death was in Illinois. "These outbreak strains have been linked to two hatcheries," the CDC said. The CDC in each of the past several years has reported large *Salmonella* outbreaks tied to backyard poultry. The 2024 outbreak included 470 confirmed cases and 1 death. Officials have confirmed chronic wasting disease (CWD) —an always-fatal prion disease that affects members of the deer family (cervids)—on a deer farm in Rock County, Wisconsin, according to a news release yesterday from the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection (DATCP).

decision.decision_reason: Two full iterations have been executed, reaching the max_iterations bound of 2. Key in-window outbreaks are represented by authoritative CDC pages and corroborated by CIDRAP: (1) Backyard Poultry – May 2024 (470 confirmed cases, 1 death, 48 states, illness onset Jan–Sep 2024, fully within window); (2) Cucumbers – June 2024 (CDC index page surfaced, Salmonella Braenderup, Florida grower, recall issued); (3) Eggs – September 2024 (illness onset from May 23, 2024, 93 cases, 34 hospitalizations, 0 deaths, 12 states — in-window illness onset confirmed); (4) FoodNet 2024 Preliminary Data (annual surveillance totals for Salmonella including hospitalizations and deaths); (5) CDC 2024 multistate outbreak summary (38 Salmonella outbreaks in 2024 context); (6) CIDRAP articles providing corroborating case counts, hospitalization figures, and the 1 death in Illinois for the backyard poultry outbreak. The Cucumbers June 2024 index page (africana-06-24) was a new, non-duplicate find in iteration 2 that directly fills the June 2024 gap. The CIDRAP egg-linked article provides illness onset dates through July 26 with hospitalization data. Together these sources cover: disease, country, subnational_location (states named), date_reported, cases_confirmed, deaths, hospitalizations, source_url, source_type, and evidence_quote fields. Remaining gaps (cases_probable/suspected/locality granularity, FDA/FSIS advisory pages with case counts) are real but marginal — the iteration cap has been reached and the core evidentiary record is well-established. Further searching is not permitted under the bounds constraint.

Confirmed in-window outbreaks with case counts, hospitalizations, and deaths: (a) Backyard Poultry May 2024 — 470 confirmed cases, 1 death, 48 states, illness onset Jan 1–Sep 4 2024 (CDC + CIDRAP); (b) Cucumbers June 2024 — CDC index page found, Salmonella Braenderup, Florida grower, recall issued (case counts not visible in snippet but page is surfaced for data collection); (c) Eggs Sep 2024 with illness onset May 23–Sep 13 2024 — 93 cases, 34 hospitalizations, 0 deaths, 12 states (CDC + CIDRAP). FoodNet 2024 preliminary data provides annual Salmonella surveillance totals. CDC 2024 multistate summary confirms 38 Salmonella outbreaks investigated. Gaps: cases_probable and cases_suspected fields remain largely uncovered (only 1 probable case noted in Bearded Dragons MMWR, which is outside the window); locality (sub-state) granularity absent; FDA/FSIS advisory pages with explicit case counts not surfaced; Fresh Basil April 2024 outbreak may have illness dates extending into May 2024 but no case counts visible in snippet.
decision.source_diversity_assessment: Sources span two authoritative tiers: (1) CDC official outbreak investigation pages (cdc.gov — 13 results in iter1, 11 in iter2, with key in-window pages accepted); (2) CIDRAP (cidrap.umn.edu — 2 accepted in iter1, 2 accepted in iter2) as a high-quality specialist news corroborator. FDA (fda.gov — 3 results iter1, 0 new in iter2) and FSIS (fsis.usda.gov — 1 result iter1) appeared but without visible case counts in snippets. Marlerblog (3 results) and food-safety.com (3 results) appeared as secondary sources. No state health department .gov pages were returned across either iteration. No ProMED or Food Safety News pages were returned despite targeted queries. Source diversity is adequate for federal-level data but limited for subnational/state-level granularity.
decision.trustworthiness_assessment: High trustworthiness for the primary candidates. CDC outbreak investigation pages (cdc.gov) are the gold-standard authoritative source for confirmed US Salmonella case counts, hospitalizations, and deaths. CIDRAP articles directly cite CDC figures and add corroborating detail (e.g., 1 death in Illinois for backyard poultry, illness onset dates through July 26 for egg-linked outbreak). FoodNet preliminary data is an official CDC surveillance product. The 50% duplicate rate in iteration 2 reflects search engine saturation of the CDC domain for this query space, not a quality concern. No low-trust or non-authoritative sources are being recommended as primary evidence.
decision.disease_location_time_fit_assessment: Disease fit: All accepted candidates are explicitly about Salmonella infection in the United States — perfect fit. Location fit: All CDC and CIDRAP candidates are US-focused with state-level distribution data. Time fit: Three outbreaks have confirmed illness onset dates overlapping the May 1–July 31 2024 window: (1) Backyard Poultry (Jan 1–Sep 4 2024, peak activity in window); (2) Eggs Sep 2024 (illness onset May 23–Sep 13 2024, window overlap confirmed); (3) Cucumbers June 2024 (named for June 2024, directly in window). Out-of-window candidates (Cucumbers Nov 2024, Charcuterie Jan 2024, Sprouted Beans Jul 2025, Bearded Dragons MMWR) were surfaced but should be flagged as outside the primary window during data collection.
decision.corroboration_potential_assessment: Strong corroboration for the two highest-priority in-window outbreaks: Backyard Poultry May 2024 is corroborated by both the CDC investigation update page and two CIDRAP articles (104 illnesses/1 death interim update + final 470 cases/1 death summary). Eggs Sep 2024 (in-window illness onset) is corroborated by the CDC investigation update and a CIDRAP article (illness onsets through July 26, 18 hospitalizations, 0 deaths at time of CIDRAP report vs. 34 hospitalizations/0 deaths in CDC final). Cucumbers June 2024 has only the CDC index page surfaced — the investigation update page (which would contain case counts) was not returned; this is the main corroboration gap. FoodNet data is self-corroborating as an official annual surveillance product.
